title: Separate stored state from time-derived views in no-op event assertions
procedure: Before asserting that a dispatched no-op preserves a public state view, inspect whether that view derives values from the current simulation clock. Snapshot the authoritative stored fields to prove nonmutation, assert the expected time-derived public values at the new tick, and preserve identity, allocation, revision and continuation checks. A stale completion may remain a live scheduled event while its lease/revision makes it a behavioral no-op; do not assume preemption cancelled it. Keep exact event identity and final completion oracles. This procedure does not authorize changes to runtime semantics.
